titulo.alumno:
«Обычай и культурный контекст»
Custom and cultural context

intro: When reading about a custom, note who practises it, in what situation and with what variation; avoid generalising to a whole society.

piezas.titulo: When reading about a custom, note who practises it, in what situation and with what variation; avoid generalising to a whole society.
texto: When reading about a custom, note who practises it, in what situation and with what variation; avoid generalising to a whole society.
A local or historical source can describe a specific practice, not a universal rule about every person.

frases.estudio: В некоторых семьях праздник отмечают дома, а в других — в ресторане.
frases.alumno: In some families the holiday is celebrated at home, and in others at a restaurant.

frases.estudio: Авторы подчёркивают, что привычки меняются в зависимости от региона и поколения.
frases.alumno: The authors stress that customs vary according to region and generation.
